The answer is **C. Every 12 hours**. Your note rules out my earlier pick of 8 hours. Of the two options left, 12 hours is the interval many UK NHS trust policies give for flushing a peripheral cannula that isn't in continuous use, usually with 0.9% sodium chloride. I'm choosing between A and C from memory of those policies, not from a source I checked.

CONFIDENCE: 68
